One reflected hand turns against the glass and comes forward through a little ring of reflected light. The traveler stays mostly within glass; empty parchment visible outside mirror. The mirror is part of the creature, a narrow simple edge around the silver glass, no decorative frame around canvas. No glass golem, no separate reflection or mirrored duplicate.
